notes: World nations bootstrap: one Earth Planet vertex and one vertex per ISO 3166-1 entry (Name = English short name, Sticker = alpha-2, prefixed code Aliases). Sovereign states are NationState; dependencies and Antarctica are Territory; Taiwan, Palestine and Western Sahara are DisputedState. Containment: nations and disputed states to Earth, dependencies to their sovereign. The United States and its five inhabited territories (Puerto Rico, Guam, American Samoa, Northern Mariana Islands, U.S. Virgin Islands) stay in us_geo_bootstrap and are referenced by temp id only; United States Minor Outlying Islands are seeded here. ProspectusIDs are derived at projection from submission_temp_id.
